title: 環境工学Ⅱ
subtitle: Environmental Engineering II
educationalGoal: The coastline of Japan is the fifth in the world, and the conservation of the coastline is an important issue. Waves are an important external force when considering coastal fluid dynamics, ecological environment, and disaster prevention. In this course, students will learn basic knowledge about the nature and deformation of waves.
advice: In this course, students will understand the basic equations describing waves and the characteristics of wave deformation, storm surge and tsunami. In the second half, students will learn about beach currents and sand drift, hydrodynamic forces acting on coastal structures, and coastal ecosystem problems. 1. Basic properties of waves 2. Wave deformation 3. Basic characteristics of wind waves 4. Long period wave 5. Coastal current 6. Sand transport 7. Hydrodynamic forces acting on coastal structures 8. Coastal ecosystem
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of physics and mathematics, and credits for hydraulics I and II are required.
